verdict.rationale: CrewAI docs claim built-in tracing/observability (performance monitoring, tracking execution times, token usage, logs/traces) and GitHub explicitly mentions real-time monitoring with metrics, logs, and traces, but there is no concrete evidence of a UI showing per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation traces, nor independent/hands-on confirmation of this granularity. missing for 10: evidence of an actual observability UI screenshot/walkthrough, independent confirmation of trace granularity down to individual LLM calls and tool invocations, and clarity on whether this is free or enterprise-only.
